cutover_phases.name: EMAIL.6 Real-Send Preflight
cutover_phases.action: Send one real magic-link email to operator address via Postmark
cutover_phases.go_gate: Email received in inbox AND Postmark dashboard shows delivered
cutover_phases.rollback: Set EMAIL_SEND_REAL=false if email not received within 5 minutes

cutover_phases.name: AUTH.7 Staging Smoke Test
cutover_phases.action: Enable AUTH_V2_ENABLED=true on staging, run all 7 smoke tests
cutover_phases.go_gate: All 7 smoke tests pass on staging
cutover_phases.rollback: Fix failures before proceeding to production

cutover_phases.name: AUTH.8 Admin-Only Enable (Production)
cutover_phases.action: Set AUTH_V2_ENABLED=true in production, test admin magic link flow
cutover_phases.go_gate: /api/auth_v2/status returns enabled:true AND magic link works AND legacy login still works
cutover_phases.rollback: fly secrets set AUTH_V2_ENABLED=false EMAIL_SEND_REAL=false && fly app restart

cutover_phases.name: AUTH.9 login.html Switch
cutover_phases.action: Promote Auth V2 to primary login form, retain legacy as fallback link
cutover_phases.go_gate: Auth V2 form functional on production, legacy still reachable, 0 JS errors
cutover_phases.flag_changes: none (env flags already set in Phase C)
cutover_phases.rollback: git revert HEAD && git push origin main

cutover_phases.name: AUTH.10 Legacy Retirement
cutover_phases.action: Remove legacy auth routes after 30-day coexistence period
cutover_phases.go_gate: Robert explicit sign-off + zero legacy auth calls in 7-day audit window
cutover_phases.rollback: Restore legacy route handlers from git history

risk_register.mitigation: Verify token in server env before Phase A

risk_register.risk: Magic link email lands in spam
risk_register.mitigation: Check spam folder in Phase A; add X-PM-Tag header
Keep legacy routes live for 30 days minimum
Verify sessions_v2 writable before Phase C

risk_register.risk: login.html CDN cache serving old version
risk_register.mitigation: Append ?v=<timestamp> or purge CDN after Phase D
